description: Retrieve synonyms for the accepted taxon linked from an AphiaID obtained with worms_resolve_taxon. Consume nextResultOffset within the same upstream offset before advancing page.nextOffset and resetting resultOffset to zero. A present name without an accepted ID has no synonym lookup; inspect it with worms_get_taxon. A full fetched 50-row page has uncertain continuation and may lead to an empty page.

anyOf.description: Positive safe-integer AphiaID; obtain from worms_resolve_taxon.

aphiaId.description: Positive safe-integer AphiaID, decimal string, or canonical urn:lsid:marinespecies.org:taxname:<AphiaID>; outputs remain numeric.

offset.description: One-based starting record, advancing by 50; default 1.

resultOffset.description: Zero-based local position; resubmit unchanged selectors and options.

Declared by this tool: `upstream_rejected`: HTTP 400/422 rejected the inputs. `upstream_rate_limited`: Upstream rate limit or local queue overflow. `upstream_access_denied`: Keyless upstream denies access. `upstream_unavailable`: Network, server, or HTML failure. `upstream_timeout`: Request or whole-tool deadline expired. `invalid_upstream_response`: Malformed or incompatible upstream response. `response_too_large`: Upstream response exceeds 8 MiB. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.
